PullRequest.Title: Support no-link local Markdown editor package overrides
PullRequest.Body:
## Summary

Allow Markdown editor webview builds to select a built local `@vscode/markdown-editor` directory through `VSCODE_MARKDOWN_EDITOR_PATH`, without `npm link`, dependency edits, or lockfile changes.

- Validate the real package directory, package name, and exports; reject invalid explicit overrides rather than falling back.
- Resolve JavaScript, exported subpaths, and CSS through esbuild package self-reference, and select the same package for command contribution generation and watch inputs.
- Preserve installed dependency resolution when the variable is unset. Standalone type checks still use installed types.
- Document the focused override workflow and test two separate local directories, installed-default selection, invalid paths/exports, CSS, and actual command generation without package links.

This independently shippable extraction from https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/343274 does not include a development graph, launcher, Hub integration, temporary configuration, build markers, incremental startup, or Windows watcher changes. The existing Mermaid build plugin is preserved.

## Validation

- Node 24: `node --test scripts/markdownEditorPackage.test.mts scripts/updateMarkdownEditorPackageJson.test.mts` — 13 tests passed.
- Focused TypeScript check of the package selector and its test — passed.
- `npm run check-markdown-editor-package-json` — manifests unchanged.
- Compared the exact base generator source at `ed9e42b5c065d9f84fc57c1bbceedddd0b73acd8` with the changed generator: both report the same three existing TS2345 interface/index-signature errors (CommandContribution, KeybindingContribution, CommandPaletteContribution). No unrelated fix is included.

- Full extension webview smoke was attempted but could not complete because the local dependency restore remained incomplete (missing Mermaid/parser/toolkit artifacts). The focused tests do successfully bundle JavaScript and CSS and execute real command generation. Dependency restore/extraction processes were stopped; no watchers or helper processes are left running.

Fixes https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/343287

Scenarios.Scenario: Default installed-package one-shot build and watch
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Package command resolution, manifest generation, and the esbuild bundle must complete before output is usable. In watch mode, the existing 100 ms event debounce precedes each rebuild.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Parcel recursively watches extension source and the installed commands-export directory.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One subscription per configured root and normally one callback wave per save.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same source and commands-export roots were watched; the diff only adds nested node_modules and .git exclusions.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: A matching event schedules the full rebuild required for updated output.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Run the full minified esbuild bundle through the esbuild service.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One full build per debounced event wave in the normal default path.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same full build ran after watched changes.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The output is unavailable until this completes.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Source-change event waves; normally one effective rebuild per wave after debouncing.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: One timer coalesces events arriving before a build starts, but there is no in-flight build sequencer. The diff does not broaden the default installed-package watch root.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Without the override, resolveMarkdownEditorPackage returns import.meta.resolve directly. Imported command modules are keyed by mtime and cached; no new package filesystem validation occurs.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the unset-environment branch and unchanged default watch target are explicit.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact bundle duration varies, but the default path adds no scaling work.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression on the installed-package path.

Scenarios.Scenario: One-shot Markdown editor build with a local override
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Override validation and command-export resolution run before watcher/build setup; manifest generation then resolves the package again before the full bundle.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: realpath the override and read/parse package.json.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Twice in a normal override build: initial selection and manifest command loading.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Installed resolution used import.meta.resolve without override validation.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Invoke esbuild.build to resolve the commands export, then invoke esbuild for the actual bundle.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Two tiny resolver builds plus one full bundle for a one-shot override build.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: No resolver builds were needed; only the required full bundle ran.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Serial resolver calls precede the required full build.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: A single selected package and its package.json/commands export; cardinality is constant rather than package-file-count dependent.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The initial resolver runs serially, then manifest generation runs before the single full build. No burst occurs.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Selection is not cached, so the one-shot build validates and resolves twice; the esbuild service can be shared within the process, and the work remains bounded.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High for the calls and cardinality; low evidence that the bounded resolver overhead is user-significant.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The two extra resolutions add constant startup latency, but their tiny inputs do not establish a material regression.
Scenarios.Verdict: No finding: extra startup work is constant and small relative to the required bundle.

Scenarios.Scenario: Local package source edit with pnpm dev and watch-markdown-editor
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The package compiler must write dist, then the final VS Code webview bundle must consume it. A bundle triggered directly by source is off the useful critical path but competes with both required stages.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Recursively watch the entire override package, including unconsumed TypeScript source and generated dist.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Source event wave plus one or more generated-output waves per save.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The watch target was the directory containing the resolved built commands export.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Source events schedule work before consumable dist changes exist.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Run a complete production/minified webview bundle for each started event wave.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Two or more full builds per save when source and dist events cross the 100 ms start threshold, versus one required build previously.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Unconsumed source edits did not directly trigger the VS Code bundle; generated built-export changes did.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The extra build consumes CPU/I/O and may run concurrently with the package compiler and final bundle, delaying usable output.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Source saves and distinct source/generated-output event waves. Effective multiplicity is one unnecessary full build plus the required build when compiler output arrives more than 100 ms after the source event; spaced output waves can queue more.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The 100 ms timer only coalesces events before buildOnce starts. Once the first build waits in the 2 s manifest debounce, later events start more buildOnce calls; these share the manifest promise and can launch full esbuild builds concurrently when it resolves. There is no in-flight limiter.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The manifest debounce coalesces command loading, but does not coalesce the enclosing full builds. Stable module URLs are cached; full bundles are not.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: dist-only consumption, the separate compiler, broad recursive root, debounce timings, and lack of in-flight serialization are explicit.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Compiler duration and watcher event grouping vary by machine, affecting prevalence and exact delay, but a greater-than-100-ms package compile is realistic.
Scenarios.Verdict: Reportable medium repeated-work/concurrency regression. report_finding was attempted but the reporting tool returned execution failures.

Scenarios.Scenario: Direct manifest generation/check with a local override
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Package validation, commands-export resolution, command module load, and manifest read/update all complete before the command exits.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Validate package.json, stat/import commands, and read or conditionally write the two extension manifests.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One package validation, one commands stat/import, two manifest reads, and up to two writes per invocation.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Command loading used import.meta.resolve; manifest reads/writes were unchanged.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: All reads and command loading are required before comparison/output.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Use a tiny esbuild build to resolve the local commands export.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: No esbuild resolver build was performed.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Adds bounded latency before command loading.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One package and the command contribution collection; no per-package-file fan-out.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Manifest files are read and conditionally written in parallel; package resolution is one serial call.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cross-process cache. Within the short-lived command, one command module is imported using its mtime.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High for the added boundary, but insufficient evidence of material impact.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact resolver startup time varies; cardinality is fixed.
Scenarios.Verdict: No finding because the added resolver work is bounded to one invocation.

Analysis.Summary: Reviewed all six changed files and traced default/override builds, watch rebuilds, and manifest generation. One medium package-root watch regression was identified; repeated report_finding calls failed at tool execution. No regression-fix learning record was warranted.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
